concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-credit-card-delete-node]] - Node.js token-based credit-card deletion through `gateway.creditCard.delete()`, with an error-only callback and Braintree's qualified PCI SAQ D warning plus recommended payment-method alternative
warnings: Preserve `Typically requires` and recommendation language; do not state that every credit-card deletion always requires SAQ D or that payment-method functions guarantee compliance.
Do not infer a result object, response fields, or a success condition from the error-only callback.
Do not import subscription cancellation, paid-service forfeiture, association removal, or other downstream effects from the separate payment-method deletion operation; this page does not state them.
Treat the linked PCI and payment-method pages as navigation unless each is fully read for a separately retained claim.
